text: How does increasing τ from 17 to 30 affect the Valid Prediction Time (VPT), according to the lab?
choices: VPT increases, because larger τ adds more memory
VPT is unchanged, because VPT depends only on reservoir size
VPT decreases, because τ=30 is more chaotic with a shorter predictability horizon
VPT becomes infinite, because the signal becomes periodic
explanation: The lab observes τ=17 (weakly chaotic) gives a longer VPT than τ=30 (more chaotic): larger τ shortens the predictability horizon (1/λ_max, where λ_max grows with τ). More chaos makes prediction harder, not easier.
